news.headline: US Postal Service whistleblower warns new system could disrupt midterm election voting
news.summary: A US Postal Service whistleblower has warned that a new ballot-processing system ordered by President Donald Trump and due to launch Tuesday could prevent millions of Americans from receiving mail ballots ahead of November's midterm elections.
